desc: PPA over expected on 1st and 2nd down. Each play is scored against the league-average play in the SAME situation (down, distance, field position). Positive = the offense beats the situation. The engine of the rating. Weight 0.14.
label: Off early-down OE

desc: PPA over expected on 3rd down. Situation-adjusted, so a team that faces long 3rd downs is not punished for the situation — only for how it performs in it. Weight 0.10.
label: Off 3rd-down OE

desc: Median distance to go on 3rd down. Shorter = the offense stays on schedule (early downs pay off). Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.06.
label: Off 3rd distance

desc: Explosiveness — share of offensive plays gaining ≥20 yards. The second, independent route to the red zone. Weight 0.10.
label: Off Exp

desc: Share of offensive drives ending in a touchdown — the end of the scoring chain. Weight 0.14.
label: Off TD%

desc: Touchdown rate on drives that entered the opponent's red zone — the finishing link. Weight 0.07.
label: Off RZ TD%

desc: Share of drives that entered the opponent's red zone — the middle link of the scoring chain. Weight 0.06.
label: Off RZ arrival

desc: Share of offensive drives ending in a field goal — drive-death efficiency; the symptom when arrival stalls. Weight 0.03.
label: Off FG%

desc: Interceptions thrown per game. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.06.
label: Off INTs

desc: Fumbles lost per game. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.04.
label: Off fumbles lost

desc: Aggression Rate — go-for-it rate × first-down conversion (rewards aggressive 4th downs that work). Weight 0.10.
label: Off AR

desc: Penalties committed per play. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.06.
label: Off penalties

desc: Yards lost per play to own penalties. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.04.
label: Off penalty yards

desc: Opponents' PPA over expected on 1st and 2nd down against this defense. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.14.
label: Def early-down OE allowed

desc: Opponents' PPA over expected on 3rd down. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.08.
label: Def 3rd-down OE allowed

desc: Median distance the OPPONENT faces on 3rd down. Longer = the defense pushes them off schedule. Weight 0.04.
label: Def forces 3rd distance

desc: Stuff rate — share of non-sack opponent plays losing ≥2 yards. Early-down prevention. Weight 0.04.
label: Def Stuff

desc: Share of opponent plays of ≥20 yards against this defense. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.10.
label: Def Exp allowed

desc: Share of opponent drives ending in a TD. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.14.
label: Def opp TD%

desc: Opponents' TD rate on drives that reached our red zone — the red-zone wall. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.08.
label: Def opp RZ TD%

desc: Share of opponent drives entering OUR red zone. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.08.
label: Def opp RZ arrival

desc: Havoc rate — share of opponent plays that are sacks or losses of ≥4 yards. Weight 0.04.
label: Def Havoc

desc: Interceptions thrown by opponents against this defense, per game. Weight 0.04.
label: Def INTs

desc: Fumbles recovered per game (takeaways). Note: forced fumbles are not tagged in the play data, so this counts recoveries. Weight 0.02.
label: Def fumbles recovered

desc: Opponents' Aggression Rate against this defense. Lower = better (opponents gain less from aggression vs us); z inverted. Weight 0.10.
label: Def AR allowed

desc: Penalties committed by this defense per play. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.06.
label: Def penalties

desc: Yards lost per play to defense penalties. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.04.
label: Def penalty yards
